item.nusmp.final_selection_wisteria_char: Normal Grade. A sprig of dried wisteria in a knot of purple thread, given to the hopefuls sent up the mountain for the night of the selection. Things that hunt in the dark dislike the smell.
A sprig of dried wisteria in a knot of purple thread, given to the hopefuls sent up the mountain for the night of the selection. Things that hunt in the dark dislike the smell.
item.nusmp.cursed_talisman_strip.card: Normal Grade. A strip of paper brushed with a ward by a first-year who was told it would work if the writing was neat. The writing is neat.
item.nusmp.cursed_talisman_strip.desc: A strip of paper brushed with a ward by a first-year who was told it would work if the writing was neat. The writing is neat.
item.nusmp.hero_course_pass_tag.card: Normal Grade. A green plastic tag on a lanyard that opens the gates of a famous hero school. The wearer stands a little straighter when it swings.
item.nusmp.hero_course_pass_tag.desc: A green plastic tag on a lanyard that opens the gates of a famous hero school. The wearer stands a little straighter when it swings.
item.nusmp.telekinesis_club_badge.card: Normal Grade. A badge of a school club that does not do what its name says and does a great deal else. A tap on it sends a small shove outward.
item.nusmp.telekinesis_club_badge.desc: A badge of a school club that does not do what its name says and does a great deal else. A tap on it sends a small shove outward.
item.nusmp.merchants_weighing_coin.card: Normal Grade. A brass coin of exactly the weight it claims, carried by a travelling merchant who counts everything twice. Fortune is kind to those who do the sums.
item.nusmp.merchants_weighing_coin.desc: A brass coin of exactly the weight it claims, carried by a travelling merchant who counts everything twice. Fortune is kind to those who do the sums.
item.nusmp.linas_fireball_tassel.card: Normal Grade. A red tassel from a certain sorceress's mantle, singed at the edges and proud of it. Flicked in anger it throws a small ball of flame.
item.nusmp.linas_fireball_tassel.desc: A red tassel from a certain sorceress's mantle, singed at the edges and proud of it. Flicked in anger it throws a small ball of flame.
item.nusmp.boar_hat_tavern_token.card: Normal Grade. A wooden token good for one drink at a tavern on the back of a very large pig. The barkeep never asks where it was got.
item.nusmp.boar_hat_tavern_token.desc: A wooden token good for one drink at a tavern on the back of a very large pig. The barkeep never asks where it was got.
item.nusmp.roxys_water_drop_charm.card: Normal Grade. A blue charm in the shape of a drop, made by an apprentice who learned water magic before she learned to smile. It cools a burn.
item.nusmp.roxys_water_drop_charm.desc: A blue charm in the shape of a drop, made by an apprentice who learned water magic before she learned to smile. It cools a burn.
item.nusmp.command_spell_ink_vial.card: Normal Grade. A small vial of red ink for the practice marks of a magus learning to draw a crest. A drop on the thumb makes the heart race.
item.nusmp.command_spell_ink_vial.desc: A small vial of red ink for the practice marks of a magus learning to draw a crest. A drop on the thumb makes the heart race.
item.nusmp.ninja_tool_pouch_charm.card: Normal Grade. A tiny canvas pouch with a clip, stuffed with wire and paper tags by an academy student who wants to look prepared. It makes the hands quicker.
item.nusmp.ninja_tool_pouch_charm.desc: A tiny canvas pouch with a clip, stuffed with wire and paper tags by an academy student who wants to look prepared. It makes the hands quicker.
item.nusmp.log_pose_keychain.card: Normal Grade. A tiny glass compass that points to the next island and nowhere else. It is the first thing a sailor learns to trust.
item.nusmp.log_pose_keychain.desc: A tiny glass compass that points to the next island and nowhere else. It is the first thing a sailor learns to trust.
item.nusmp.nen_water_divination_cup.card: Normal Grade. A thin glass cup with a leaf floating on the water, used by beginners to learn what kind of aura they have. The leaf turns, and it means something.
item.nusmp.nen_water_divination_cup.desc: A thin glass cup with a leaf floating on the water, used by beginners to learn what kind of aura they have. The leaf turns, and it means something.
item.nusmp.capsule_corp_capsule_case.car: Normal Grade. A blue case of numbered capsules, most of them holding nothing more exciting than a bed. The first one always holds a bandage.
item.nusmp.capsule_corp_capsule_case.des: A blue case of numbered capsules, most of them holding nothing more exciting than a bed. The first one always holds a bandage.
item.nusmp.soul_reaper_academy_badge.car: Normal Grade. A grey badge handed to those who pass the entrance to a spirit academy. The rank is very low, and the pride is very high.
item.nusmp.soul_reaper_academy_badge.des: A grey badge handed to those who pass the entrance to a spirit academy. The rank is very low, and the pride is very high.
item.nusmp.himmels_statue_pebble.card: Normal Grade. A grey pebble chipped from the foot of a statue that was built because someone kept a promise. Looking at it makes the next step easy.
item.nusmp.himmels_statue_pebble.desc: A grey pebble chipped from the foot of a statue that was built because someone kept a promise. Looking at it makes the next step easy.
item.nusmp.cooked_mandrake_sprig.card: Normal Grade. A dried sprig tied with thread, kept by a cook who knows that every mandrake is a stew in waiting. The scent is oddly calming.
item.nusmp.cooked_mandrake_sprig.desc: A dried sprig tied with thread, kept by a cook who knows that every mandrake is a stew in waiting. The scent is oddly calming.
item.nusmp.millennium_puzzle_replica.car: Normal Grade. A toy replica of a golden puzzle, sold at the game shop for those who want to feel clever. The pieces fit together after a good deal of patience.
item.nusmp.millennium_puzzle_replica.des: A toy replica of a golden puzzle, sold at the game shop for those who want to feel clever. The pieces fit together after a good deal of patience.
item.nusmp.aladdins_flute_replica.card: Normal Grade. A pipe of blue-painted wood sold to children in the streets of Balbadd. It makes no real sound, but the child who blows it believes in magic.
item.nusmp.aladdins_flute_replica.desc: A pipe of blue-painted wood sold to children in the streets of Balbadd. It makes no real sound, but the child who blows it believes in magic.
item.nusmp.grimoire_page_scrap.card: Normal Grade. A torn corner of a blank page from a grimoire that never answered its owner. It is still faintly warm.
item.nusmp.grimoire_page_scrap.desc: A torn corner of a blank page from a grimoire that never answered its owner. It is still faintly warm.
item.nusmp.wave_fragment_sliver.card: Normal Grade. A shard from the edge of the Wave, collected by volunteers who then found they could not put it down. It hums softly.
item.nusmp.wave_fragment_sliver.desc: A shard from the edge of the Wave, collected by volunteers who then found they could not put it down. It hums softly.
item.nusmp.dungeon_key_fragment.card: Normal Grade. A chipped piece of a gate key that does not open anything any more. The glow inside it dims and brightens like breath.
item.nusmp.dungeon_key_fragment.desc: A chipped piece of a gate key that does not open anything any more. The glow inside it dims and brightens like breath.
item.nusmp.subarus_track_jacket_zipper.c: Normal Grade. A bright orange zipper pull from a very odd jacket that people kept staring at. Pulling it feels like starting over.
item.nusmp.subarus_track_jacket_zipper.d: A bright orange zipper pull from a very odd jacket that people kept staring at. Pulling it feels like starting over.
item.nusmp.explosion_fan_club_pin.card: Normal Grade. A red pin of an oddly devout fan club. Its members shout a single word at sunrise and consider it a good day.
item.nusmp.explosion_fan_club_pin.desc: A red pin of an oddly devout fan club. Its members shout a single word at sunrise and consider it a good day.
item.nusmp.elder_lich_apprentice_bone_ch: Normal Grade. A small knuckle bone strung on a cord, handed out to the lowest ranks of a tomb's undead scribes. It rattles politely.
A small knuckle bone strung on a cord, handed out to the lowest ranks of a tomb's undead scribes. It rattles politely.
item.nusmp.aincrad_teleport_crystal_chip: Normal Grade. A cheap chip of blue crystal from the first floor's market, good for nothing but luck. Players carry them to remind themselves that the next floor is up.
A cheap chip of blue crystal from the first floor's market, good for nothing but luck. Players carry them to remind themselves that the next floor is up.
item.nusmp.hearth_warm_pocket_stone.card: Normal Grade. A flat stone kept by the fire all evening and carried in a pocket the next day. It is warm for hours and has saved a great many fingers.
item.nusmp.hearth_warm_pocket_stone.desc: A flat stone kept by the fire all evening and carried in a pocket the next day. It is warm for hours and has saved a great many fingers.
item.nusmp.rogues_black_cowl.card: Normal Grade. A plain black cowl with a half mask, bought in a back alley from a man who did not give a name. It is the uniform of those who want to be forgotten.
item.nusmp.rogues_black_cowl.desc: A plain black cowl with a half mask, bought in a back alley from a man who did not give a name. It is the uniform of those who want to be forgotten.
item.nusmp.wizards_apprentice_pointed_ha: Normal Grade. A purple hat with a floppy point and a brass buckle, worn by a young mage who has not yet found out why the brim is so wide.
A purple hat with a floppy point and a brass buckle, worn by a young mage who has not yet found out why the brim is so wide.
item.nusmp.sand_village_travellers_hat.c: Normal Grade. A conical straw hat worn in the dry lands to keep the sun off the face. The brim is stitched with a small wind sign.
item.nusmp.sand_village_travellers_hat.d: A conical straw hat worn in the dry lands to keep the sun off the face. The brim is stitched with a small wind sign.
item.nusmp.marine_recruit_cap.card: Normal Grade. A white cap with a blue band and the word for justice stitched across the front. The recruit is sure it will be a good one.
item.nusmp.marine_recruit_cap.desc: A white cap with a blue band and the word for justice stitched across the front. The recruit is sure it will be a good one.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_goggles.card: Normal Grade. A pair of scratched goggles from the first stage of a certain exam, pushed up on the forehead. The wearer sees danger sooner than the others do.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_goggles.desc: A pair of scratched goggles from the first stage of a certain exam, pushed up on the forehead. The wearer sees danger sooner than the others do.
item.nusmp.hero_costume_visor.card: Normal Grade. A light visor from a student's costume, chosen for the way it looks in photographs. It also takes a blow.
item.nusmp.hero_costume_visor.desc: A light visor from a student's costume, chosen for the way it looks in photographs. It also takes a blow.
item.nusmp.village_militia_kettle_helm.c: Normal Grade. An open iron kettle helm handed out when a village is told that the Waves are coming. The rim is dented from a good many dinners.
item.nusmp.village_militia_kettle_helm.d: An open iron kettle helm handed out when a village is told that the Waves are coming. The rim is dented from a good many dinners.
item.nusmp.travellers_mage_cap.card: Normal Grade. A soft cap with a feather, worn by a mage who prefers a long walk to a short spell. Mana runs a little more freely under it.
item.nusmp.travellers_mage_cap.desc: A soft cap with a feather, worn by a mage who prefers a long walk to a short spell. Mana runs a little more freely under it.
item.nusmp.hollow_mask_fragment.card: Normal Grade. A small chip of bone-white mask, kept like a tooth. It does not speak but it does not seem entirely quiet.
item.nusmp.hollow_mask_fragment.desc: A small chip of bone-white mask, kept like a tooth. It does not speak but it does not seem entirely quiet.
item.nusmp.sorceress_silver_tiara.card: Normal Grade. A thin silver tiara with a single red bead, worn by a girl who has blown up more towns than she will admit. It sits straight in all weather.
item.nusmp.sorceress_silver_tiara.desc: A thin silver tiara with a single red bead, worn by a girl who has blown up more towns than she will admit. It sits straight in all weather.
item.nusmp.holy_knight_recruits_helm.car: Normal Grade. A burnished helm with a gold edge, issued before the recruits were told what the order truly did. It still turns a blow well.
item.nusmp.holy_knight_recruits_helm.des: A burnished helm with a gold edge, issued before the recruits were told what the order truly did. It still turns a blow well.
item.nusmp.demon_slayer_corps_hairpin.ca: Normal Grade. A plain hairpin with a dark stone, handed to every new member of a secret corps. It holds the hair in place when the night gets long.
item.nusmp.demon_slayer_corps_hairpin.de: A plain hairpin with a dark stone, handed to every new member of a secret corps. It holds the hair in place when the night gets long.
item.nusmp.adventurers_guild_bandana.car: Normal Grade. A faded bandana that marks the lowest rank of a northern guild. It keeps the sweat from the eyes and has been washed at least twice.
item.nusmp.adventurers_guild_bandana.des: A faded bandana that marks the lowest rank of a northern guild. It keeps the sweat from the eyes and has been washed at least twice.
item.nusmp.lantern_keepers_cap.card: Normal Grade. A flat cap with a small brass lamp on the front, worn by a keeper who walks the tunnels at dusk. The light is small and steady.
item.nusmp.lantern_keepers_cap.desc: A flat cap with a small brass lamp on the front, worn by a keeper who walks the tunnels at dusk. The light is small and steady.
item.nusmp.padded_gambeson.card: Normal Grade. A quilted coat of linen and wool that every soldier wears under his mail, and more than a few wear alone. It is hot, heavy and kind to ribs.
item.nusmp.padded_gambeson.desc: A quilted coat of linen and wool that every soldier wears under his mail, and more than a few wear alone. It is hot, heavy and kind to ribs.
item.nusmp.guild_mages_travelling_vest.c: Normal Grade. A bright vest with the guild's mark on the back, worn by mages who jump off trains. It is cut loose and pockets a great many odds.
item.nusmp.guild_mages_travelling_vest.d: A bright vest with the guild's mark on the back, worn by mages who jump off trains. It is cut loose and pockets a great many odds.
Normal Grade. A navy jacket of the training yards, stained with grass and faded at the elbows. The squad's clover is still bright on the sleeve.
A navy jacket of the training yards, stained with grass and faded at the elbows. The squad's clover is still bright on the sleeve.
item.nusmp.chunin_flak_vest.card: Normal Grade. A green flak vest with many pockets, issued after a rank exam and used for every sort of tool. Its padding stops more than it looks.
item.nusmp.chunin_flak_vest.desc: A green flak vest with many pockets, issued after a rank exam and used for every sort of tool. Its padding stops more than it looks.
item.nusmp.pirates_striped_shirt.card: Normal Grade. A striped shirt that smells of salt and a little of rum. Whoever wears it feels they might do something reckless and be fine.
item.nusmp.pirates_striped_shirt.desc: A striped shirt that smells of salt and a little of rum. Whoever wears it feels they might do something reckless and be fine.
item.nusmp.hunter_candidates_travel_coat: Normal Grade. A green travel coat with deep pockets and a number pinned inside the collar. It has sat through many a night on a cold road.
A green travel coat with deep pockets and a number pinned inside the collar. It has sat through many a night on a cold road.
item.nusmp.gym_uniform_of_the_hero_cours: Gym Uniform of the Hero Course
Normal Grade. A light blue and red tracksuit for a day of field trials. It is made to stretch and does not complain.
A light blue and red tracksuit for a day of field trials. It is made to stretch and does not complain.
item.nusmp.jujutsu_high_uniform_jacket.c: Normal Grade. A dark jacket with a high collar, worn by students whose duty it is to look after things most people never see. It is woven with a faint ward.
item.nusmp.jujutsu_high_uniform_jacket.d: A dark jacket with a high collar, worn by students whose duty it is to look after things most people never see. It is woven with a faint ward.
item.nusmp.corps_uniform_shirt.card: Normal Grade. A plain black uniform with a row of metal buttons, the same in every season. The stitching is of a kind that does not tear.
item.nusmp.corps_uniform_shirt.desc: A plain black uniform with a row of metal buttons, the same in every season. The stitching is of a kind that does not tear.

item.nusmp.lightweight_player_coat.desc: A dark long coat sold in a market on the lower floors to those who prefer speed to protection. It flaps in a way that makes the wearer think he looks heroic.
item.nusmp.merchants_fur_lined_coat.card: Normal Grade. A heavy coat with a fur collar for long trips on a cold trade road. A little pouch inside always holds a coin or two.
item.nusmp.merchants_fur_lined_coat.desc: A heavy coat with a fur collar for long trips on a cold trade road. A little pouch inside always holds a coin or two.
item.nusmp.adventurers_cooking_smock.car: Normal Grade. A grey-green smock splattered with sauce, worn by those who think a dungeon is mostly a kitchen. The sleeves are stiff with old broth.
item.nusmp.adventurers_cooking_smock.des: A grey-green smock splattered with sauce, worn by those who think a dungeon is mostly a kitchen. The sleeves are stiff with old broth.
item.nusmp.wandering_mages_mantle_cuiras: Normal Grade. A wine red robe with a pair of shoulder guards, flapping and altogether proud. The guards do very little, and they look dramatic.
A wine red robe with a pair of shoulder guards, flapping and altogether proud. The guards do very little, and they look dramatic.
item.nusmp.rain_slick_oilskin_jacket.car: Normal Grade. A yellow waxed jacket worn by fishermen and quarry guards. It sheds rain, wind and the stares of strangers.
item.nusmp.rain_slick_oilskin_jacket.des: A yellow waxed jacket worn by fishermen and quarry guards. It sheds rain, wind and the stares of strangers.
item.nusmp.ogre_village_rope_belt.card: Normal Grade. A thick rope belt tied by the ogres of a village rebuilt after a fire. It is knotted for strength, and the knot is called Friend.
item.nusmp.ogre_village_rope_belt.desc: A thick rope belt tied by the ogres of a village rebuilt after a fire. It is knotted for strength, and the knot is called Friend.

item.nusmp.kouhas_silk_sash.desc: A glossy silk sash from the courts of the east, folded in a showy bow. The silk is slippery, and so is the wearer.

item.nusmp.adventurers_potion_holster.de: A leather belt with a loop for the vial every adventurer is told to keep for the bad days. It has never been the wrong size.
item.nusmp.hunters_utility_belt.card: Normal Grade. A black belt with clips for everything a raider might need to lift off a dead monster. A pouch of it is always full.
item.nusmp.hunters_utility_belt.desc: A black belt with clips for everything a raider might need to lift off a dead monster. A pouch of it is always full.
item.nusmp.lucys_key_ring_belt.card: Normal Grade. A belt with a ring of tiny golden keys, each of which has a face and a temper. They jingle when the wearer lies.
item.nusmp.lucys_key_ring_belt.desc: A belt with a ring of tiny golden keys, each of which has a face and a temper. They jingle when the wearer lies.
item.nusmp.kunai_holster_strap.card: Normal Grade. A wrap of dark cloth that holds a few kunai at the hip. The wearer learns to reach without looking.
item.nusmp.kunai_holster_strap.desc: A wrap of dark cloth that holds a few kunai at the hip. The wearer learns to reach without looking.
item.nusmp.straw_hat_crew_sash.card: Normal Grade. A yellow sash knotted in the way of a certain crew, pulled tight before every adventure. Nobody knows who taught them the knot.
item.nusmp.straw_hat_crew_sash.desc: A yellow sash knotted in the way of a certain crew, pulled tight before every adventure. Nobody knows who taught them the knot.
item.nusmp.servants_contract_belt.card: Normal Grade. A dark belt with an engraved plate that pairs a master with whoever answered the call. It sits there like a promise.
item.nusmp.servants_contract_belt.desc: A dark belt with an engraved plate that pairs a master with whoever answered the call. It sits there like a promise.
item.nusmp.witch_cult_prayer_cord.card: Normal Grade. A knotted cord of dark thread tied by a cult that had no business doing so. Whoever wears it feels as if a stranger were looking over a shoulder.
item.nusmp.witch_cult_prayer_cord.desc: A knotted cord of dark thread tied by a cult that had no business doing so. Whoever wears it feels as if a stranger were looking over a shoulder.
item.nusmp.zanpakuto_sheath_sash.card: Normal Grade. A white sash that holds a sheathed blade at the hip, tied by a reaper in a particular way. A sword sits easier on it.
item.nusmp.zanpakuto_sheath_sash.desc: A white sash that holds a sheathed blade at the hip, tied by a reaper in a particular way. A sword sits easier on it.
Normal Grade. A belt with a coin pouch that has been empty more often than not. Hope still lives in its stitching.
A belt with a coin pouch that has been empty more often than not. Hope still lives in its stitching.
item.nusmp.pilgrims_knotted_rope_cord.ca: Normal Grade. A rope cord with a knot tied at every shrine its owner has visited. The wearer feels the number of the miles.
item.nusmp.pilgrims_knotted_rope_cord.de: A rope cord with a knot tied at every shrine its owner has visited. The wearer feels the number of the miles.
item.nusmp.rimurus_slime_pendant.card: Normal Grade. A small pendant in the shape of a smiling slime, sold in a town that remembers who built it. It is soft to the touch and does not break.
item.nusmp.rimurus_slime_pendant.desc: A small pendant in the shape of a smiling slime, sold in a town that remembers who built it. It is soft to the touch and does not break.
item.nusmp.four_leaf_clover_locket.card: Normal Grade. A locket with a pressed clover inside, given by a mother who hoped for the best. It opens on the first try, which is a kind of luck.
item.nusmp.four_leaf_clover_locket.desc: A locket with a pressed clover inside, given by a mother who hoped for the best. It opens on the first try, which is a kind of luck.
item.nusmp.djinn_vessel_replica_amulet.c: Normal Grade. A cheap brass copy of a treasure that holds a great being, sold on the roads to those who want to feel they own a miracle. It is nice and heavy.
item.nusmp.djinn_vessel_replica_amulet.d: A cheap brass copy of a treasure that holds a great being, sold on the roads to those who want to feel they own a miracle. It is nice and heavy.
item.nusmp.goddess_blessing_medallion.ca: Normal Grade. A thin medallion warmed by a small goddess's palm on the night she accepted her first child. It beats with a faint pulse.
item.nusmp.goddess_blessing_medallion.de: A thin medallion warmed by a small goddess's palm on the night she accepted her first child. It beats with a faint pulse.
Normal Grade. A pendant formed like a silver key, carried by a girl in case the summons is answered. The teeth are bent from over-use.
A pendant formed like a silver key, carried by a girl in case the summons is answered. The teeth are bent from over-use.
Normal Grade. A string of gold-washed coins that glints in the light of a great tomb's lamps. They are fake, and the guards know it.
A string of gold-washed coins that glints in the light of a great tomb's lamps. They are fake, and the guards know it.
item.nusmp.spirit_tortoise_scale_charm.c: Normal Grade. A smooth green scale on a cord, shed by a tortoise as large as a hill. It dulls the edge of a blow.
item.nusmp.spirit_tortoise_scale_charm.d: A smooth green scale on a cord, shed by a tortoise as large as a hill. It dulls the edge of a blow.
item.nusmp.four_star_ball_pendant.card: Normal Grade. A glass bead holding four red stars, made as a copy of something far more valuable. Its warmth makes a body think of home.
item.nusmp.four_star_ball_pendant.desc: A glass bead holding four red stars, made as a copy of something far more valuable. Its warmth makes a body think of home.
item.nusmp.spirit_mediums_salt_pouch.car: Normal Grade. A tiny pouch of salt hung on a cord by a young man who had no need of one. It is surprisingly effective at keeping things away.
item.nusmp.spirit_mediums_salt_pouch.des: A tiny pouch of salt hung on a cord by a young man who had no need of one. It is surprisingly effective at keeping things away.
item.nusmp.prayer_bead_necklace.card: Normal Grade. A loop of dark wooden beads rubbed smooth by a priest's fingers. Each bead is a prayer, and a few are for the wearer.
item.nusmp.prayer_bead_necklace.desc: A loop of dark wooden beads rubbed smooth by a priest's fingers. Each bead is a prayer, and a few are for the wearer.
item.nusmp.wolf_tooth_pendant.card: Normal Grade. A tooth worn smooth on a leather thong, said to be from a harvest god of the north. A farmer's luck sleeps in it.
item.nusmp.wolf_tooth_pendant.desc: A tooth worn smooth on a leather thong, said to be from a harvest god of the north. A farmer's luck sleeps in it.
item.nusmp.demon_blood_talisman_chip.car: Normal Grade. A chip of red stone said to be a demon's blood turned hard. It is a fine thing to be seen with and a poor thing to try to sell.
item.nusmp.demon_blood_talisman_chip.des: A chip of red stone said to be a demon's blood turned hard. It is a fine thing to be seen with and a poor thing to try to sell.
item.nusmp.bedroll_and_pack.card: Normal Grade. A rolled blanket strapped over a pack, with a tin cup tied to the top. The first thing an adventurer buys and the last thing he leaves.
item.nusmp.bedroll_and_pack.desc: A rolled blanket strapped over a pack, with a tin cup tied to the top. The first thing an adventurer buys and the last thing he leaves.
Normal Grade. A pale green cape for scouts of the great forest, soaked in sap to keep off the insects. It rustles as leaves do.
A pale green cape for scouts of the great forest, soaked in sap to keep off the insects. It rustles as leaves do.
Normal Grade. A cloak stitched from the leftovers of many cloaks, one square for every child in the village. It keeps in the heat well.
A cloak stitched from the leftovers of many cloaks, one square for every child in the village. It keeps in the heat well.
item.nusmp.leaf_village_messenger_satche: Normal Grade. A canvas satchel with a scroll tube, the daily kit of a runner who carries mail between camps. It has hardly any weight.
A canvas satchel with a scroll tube, the daily kit of a runner who carries mail between camps. It has hardly any weight.

item.nusmp.climbers_chalked_gloves.card: Normal Grade. Fingerless gloves dusted white with chalk, worn on a long climb. A hand on the rock finds a hold.
item.nusmp.climbers_chalked_gloves.desc: Fingerless gloves dusted white with chalk, worn on a long climb. A hand on the rock finds a hold.
item.nusmp.selection_hopefuls_bokken.des: A plain oak training sword carried up the mountain by the hopefuls of the final selection, worn smooth by a month of cuts before breakfast. It teaches a clean line before a sharp one. Use: Oak Cut.
item.nusmp.selection_hopefuls_bokken.car:
Normal Grade katana (24.5 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Oak Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You cut the way you were drilled, and the line is clean.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.genin_academy_kunai.desc: The plain black kunai handed to every graduate of the leaf academy with a lecture about not throwing it at friends. It is balanced for throwing and fine for peeling fruit. Use: Kunai Throw.
item.nusmp.genin_academy_kunai.card:
Normal Grade dagger (20 damage, 2.2 attacks a second).
Kunai Throw (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): You flick the kunai and it bites.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.east_blue_cutlass.desc: A curved sailor's cutlass with a basket guard, bought cheap from a harbour smith by anyone who wanted to look like a pirate and then learned to be one. It cuts rope and rivals alike. Use: Deck Slash.
item.nusmp.east_blue_cutlass.card:
Normal Grade sabre (23.5 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Deck Slash (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): A wide cut across the deck, and the nearest ones step back.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.
item.nusmp.axel_frontier_club.desc: A knotty oak club with a few iron nails driven through the end, favoured by the beginner adventurers of a town at the edge of the demon king's lands. It is stronger than its owner usually is. Use: Frontier Bash.
item.nusmp.axel_frontier_club.card:
Normal Grade club (25.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second).
Frontier Bash (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): A heavy swing that leaves the nearest ones dazed.
Tensura engravings: crushing.
item.nusmp.apprentice_birch_wand.desc: A slim birch wand cut and polished by a village mage for her first apprentice. It throws a little spark and teaches that magic mostly means patience. Use: Petal Spark.
item.nusmp.apprentice_birch_wand.card:
Normal Grade wand (20.5 damage, 1.5 attacks a second).
Petal Spark (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): A pale green spark leaps from the tip.
Tensura engravings: magic weapon.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_machete.desc: A broad bush machete issued at a swamp checkpoint to those who still believed the exam was a walk in the woods. It hacks vines and the occasional liar. Use: Brush Cut.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_machete.card:
Normal Grade cleaver (24 damage, 1.6 attacks a second).
Brush Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You hack a wide arc through the undergrowth and whatever hides in it.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.
